dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In Inazuma, people who wear swords on their waists are a minority. Most soldiers use spears.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be that swords are a symbol of status... Should we wear them as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the swords here are all too big for Paimon... There's no other way, we'll have to find a famous swordsmith to make a custom one!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A custom-made sword will cost a lot of Mora though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you saying that Mora is more important than the desires of your lovely companion?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Actually, I've already prepared something for you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Really? Let's have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Isn't that the knife we use to cut fruit?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, at least it's the right size for you...

choices.text: Ahem, "What matters isn't the value of the sword..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice try, but Paimon won't fall for this, no matter how cool it sounds!
